title: AFK Massaman Curry
description:
INGREDIENTS - 4 SERVINGS

1kg lean lamb leg (divide into 4 pieces - use lean chuck or even skinless thigh)
60g Massaman curry paste (Maesri or similar)
200ml full-fat coconut milk
300ml water1 onion, sliced 2cm thick
600g cocktail potatoes (halved if using chicken thigh)
2 star anise
1 cinnamon stick

INSTRUCTION

1. Preheat oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
2. Whisk the curry paste, coconut milk and stock together in a baking dish/oven safe pot. Onion, potato, star anise, cinnamon and raw lamb in → turn everything to coat. That’s it.
3. Cover with foil → bake 2-3 hours.
4. Uncover → bake a further 15 minutes at 230, until the lamb is charred and the sauce has reduced a little.
5. Skim any surface fat before serving — tilt the dish, it lifts off easily.
6. Chilli and coriander over the top.
